dev-board-dock.title: Dev-board dock
dev-board-dock.blurb: Holds a Pi Zero / Zero 2 W and a Pico on locating pegs and an ESP32 DevKitC in an edge cradle, 10 mm off the floor so header tails never take the weight.
dev-board-dock.print_notes: Plate on the bed, no supports, 0.2 mm layers, 3 walls, 15% infill. Pegs are 2.35/1.7 mm: print slower for the top 3 mm or ream with a drill.

solder-station.title: Solder station insert
solder-station.blurb: Pockets for a 10 ml flux syringe (lying diagonally), a 40 mm wick reel on a spin axle with a feed slot, a 22 mm solder tube and a 30 mm tip-tinner tin.
solder-station.material: PETG or ASA (it lives next to the iron); never rest the hot tip on any print
solder-station.print_notes: Upright, no supports, 3 walls, 10-15% infill. Round trough bottoms print as steep overhangs and come out fine; the 1 mm ribs between pockets need 0.4 mm nozzle.

parts-grid-2x2.title: Small-parts grid 4x4
parts-grid-2x2.blurb: Lift-out tray of sixteen 18 mm cups with 5 mm scooped floors for SMD parts, screws and standoffs; swap whole trays between crates.
